title: trema orientale var. rigidum
intro: Trema orientale var. rigidum, commonly known as the Indian lead tree, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the family Cannabaceae. The Indian lead tree is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities that provide potential health benefits such as wound healing, antidiabetic properties, and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Trema orientale var. rigidum include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
